avoid.product_type: Apple-branded products (AirPods, AirTag, iPad, Apple Watch, EarPods)
avoid.reason: All Apple products are heavily brand-locked, cannot be legitimately dropshipped, and Amazon listings for these are dominated by Apple's own seller account and authorized resellers — margin is nonexistent for third-party sellers.

avoid.product_type: Amazon-branded products (Echo Dot, Fire TV Stick, Amazon Basics lines)
avoid.reason: Amazon Basics and Amazon's own devices are sold directly by Amazon at lowest possible prices with zero room for third-party margin — competing against the platform itself is a guaranteed loss.

avoid.product_type: Roku streaming devices and TV remotes
avoid.reason: Roku devices are a heavily branded category dominated by the manufacturer and major electronics retailers, with thin margins and no supplier access outside authorized channels — unsuitable for dropshipping.

avoid.product_type: Skullcandy branded earbuds and branded Sony headphones
avoid.reason: Brand-name audio products like Skullcandy and Sony cannot be legitimately dropshipped, and counterfeit versions carry serious legal and platform suspension risks — source only unbranded generic equivalents.

avoid.product_type: Ultra-low-ticket commodity items under $12 (basic ant bait stations, cheap hangers priced below cost)
avoid.reason: Items that retail under $12 leave insufficient margin after platform fees, payment processing, and shipping costs — only viable as bundle upsells, not standalone dropship SKUs.

analysis.market_insights:
Mid-August 2026 represents one of the highest-velocity dropshipping windows of the year, driven almost entirely by the back-to-school and college dorm move-in cycle. The Amazon data is unusually concentrated in a handful of micro-categories — power strips, bedding, kids headphones, and pest control — all of which are hitting their annual demand apex simultaneously this week. Dropshippers who act in the next 7–10 days on these categories can capture peak conversion rates before inventory at supplier level tightens and listing competition intensifies from larger operators who already have FBA stock in warehouses.

Looking 6–12 weeks forward, the smart play is to begin transitioning product research toward fall and early holiday categories: heated blankets, smart home accessories, essential oil diffusers, and Halloween decor. The absence of TikTok and Google Trends data in this analysis is a significant gap — the products recommended here are grounded in Amazon demand signals only, which means you may be missing early-stage viral products that haven't yet migrated to Amazon bestseller lists. Cross-referencing TikTok Shop trending products daily and monitoring Google Shopping query data for the identified keywords would substantially sharpen the confidence levels on several mid-tier recommendations.
analysis.data_quality_note: Only Amazon bestseller data was available in this analysis — TikTok trending product data and Google Trends query data were absent, meaning all recommendations are based solely on Amazon demand signals and seasonal inference, which reduces confidence on 'rising_fast' and 'buy_soon' items that rely on cross-platform correlation.
